items.title: Does Earnings Beat Change The Bull Case For Emerson Electric Stock (EMR)?
items.summary: Emerson Electric reported fourth quarter sales of US$5.2b and full year sales of US$19.0b, with higher net income and earnings per share than the prior year. The company also announced a 7% quarterly dividend increase to US$0.595 per share and issued fiscal 2027 guidance that includes about 5% net sales growth.
